_note: Townspeople. 'label' is shown in the status strip when you press action next to them (until conversation arrives in milestone 4). 'sprite' is their picture in art/sprites.json; a second frame named like 'npc_innkeeper_2' makes them animate. Until a role has its own sprite, 'standIn' is drawn instead. walkSpeed is in tiles per second; talkReach is how close (in tiles, feet to feet) you must be to talk to someone; pauses and walks are in game updates (60 a second), picked at random between the two numbers.
